english_draft:
Meta reported Q4 2025 results on January 28, 2026. This historical preview uses only that release.
Q4 revenue was USD 59.893 billion. Revenue rose 24 percent year over year.
Operating income was USD 24.745 billion. Operating margin was 41 percent. Diluted EPS was USD 8.88.
Family daily active people averaged 3.58 billion in December 2025. That was up 7 percent year over year.
Capital expenditure including finance leases was USD 22.14 billion. Operating cash flow was USD 36.21 billion. Free cash flow was USD 14.08 billion.
For Q1 2026, Meta expects revenue of USD 53.5 billion to USD 56.5 billion. The midpoint is USD 55.0 billion. This midpoint is about 8.2 percent below Q4 revenue.
The source does not give Q1 2025 revenue. Therefore, this preview does not calculate a year-over-year expectation.
The main questions are: (1) Can revenue stay at or above the midpoint? (2) Can operating margin remain near 41 percent? (3) Can free cash flow absorb continued high capex?
Positive difference: revenue near or above the upper end, or margin above 41 percent. Negative difference: revenue below the lower end, or margin materially below 41 percent.
At the report, verify revenue, operating margin, capex, free cash flow, DAP, and EPS.
As of the cutoff, Q1 2026 actual results were not available. There is no contemporaneous preview to review.

fact_checks: 日期/季度核对：来源为2025Q4及全年业绩新闻稿，发布于2026-01-28；本稿目标为2026Q1，截止时间2026-01-28T23:59:59，符合。
币种/单位核对：收入、利润、现金流单位为十亿美元；EPS为美元/股；DAP为十亿人。
GAAP核对：来源中的经营利润和EPS为GAAP口径；本稿未混入非GAAP。
集团/分部核对：所有指标均为Meta集团整体，未拆分广告或Reality Labs。
事实/指引/推论核对：Q4业绩为已公布事实；Q1收入指引53.5–56.5B为公司预测；环比约-8.2%及Q4 capex占收入约37%均为本稿按指引中点与Q4实际数据计算的推论。
范围限制核对：未使用市场共识、股价或未披露产品利润；未使用2026Q1财报后信息；不存在财报前同期Preview，因此不事后补写分析。
